note: JAAMAS revision campaigns. E0 is the submitted evidence and is never re-written. Every other campaign writes only under outputs/revision/<campaign_id>/ and is promoted to revision/data/<campaign_id>/ after validation.

E0.description: Submitted campaign (experiment_spec_id blade-core-eval-v2). Anvil started without --hardfork, so the effective hardfork was the Anvil 1.7.1 default (`latest`, reported by anvil_nodeInfo as Bpo1) while contracts were compiled for evm_version cancun.

E0R.role: Reproduction check of E0 through this runner: same Core, Anvil default hardfork, legacy payload encoding. Must reproduce every transaction_gas_used of data/raw/*.jsonl.

E1H.role: Original Core, explicit Cancun, legacy payload encoding. E1H - E0 isolates the hardfork correction.

E1.role: Original Core with the corrected methodology (explicit Cancun, no redundant inbound payload). E1 - E1H isolates the payload correction.

E2.role: Corrected Core (Request correlation fix) with the corrected methodology. E2 - E1 isolates the Core correction.

E2-EV-NORECV.role: Experimental counterfactual (not a BLADE release): E2 Core without the Agent.Received emission.

E2-EV-NOPHASE.role: Experimental counterfactual (not a BLADE release): E2 Core without RequestAdvanced, ContractNetSlot and ContractNetParticipantPhase emissions.

E2-EV-NONE.role: Experimental counterfactual (not a BLADE release): E2 Core without any event emission.

E2-MOBS.role: Purpose-built baseline with observability equivalent to BLADE (same event signatures and emission points). BLADE side identical to E2.

E2-MCORR.role: Purpose-built Request baseline with explicit single-use correlation tokens (sensitivity bound for the E2 correlation guarantee). BLADE side identical to E2.

E2-MCOBS.role: Purpose-built baseline with both the E2 correlation guarantee and BLADE-equivalent observability (Request: correlated-observable; Contract Net: observable). BLADE side identical to E2.

S-NONCE.role: EXPERIMENTAL STUDY, not a campaign and not E3: Core 4b60b86 with the nonce-packing patch (revision/src/core-variants/nonce-packed). Measured only on the 'nonce' matrix for comparison with E2; not to be reported as a BLADE result.

S-E2REF.role: Reference re-measurement of E2 on the 'nonce' matrix with the current runner (nonce study baseline and runner reproducibility check against revision/data/E2). Not a separate campaign.

historical.description: Submitted tests unchanged plus revision tests. Used for the original Core (E0R, E1H, E1).

token.description: Corrected Core (token correlation). Submitted tests that cannot express the token are replaced by complete ports; ContractNetEquivalence runs unchanged.

RequestEquivalence.t.sol.reason: Original continuations carry no correlation token; the corrected Core rejects them with ReplyWithMismatch. The port keeps all 10 original tests (same state assertions), reads the Core-assigned token, and adds test_staleInboundAfterReuse and test_tokenOnlyWhenCoreAssigns. test_invalid_wrongPeer now sends the correct token so the rejection is attributable to the peer check (selector asserted).

ParametricEquivalence.t.sol.reason: Same 13 cells and state assertions with token-aware continuations. Payload delivery is asserted on recorded call data for every recipient (exactly once) plus Received contents; the N=8 cell must pass instead of being skippable.

StoragePilot.t.sol.reason: The original requires zero non-zero slots at the terminal message; the corrected Core keeps one persistent nonce slot at the initiator by design. The port keeps the three probes (R3 payloads, active K with isolation, CN A N=2), requires session slots to return to zero, live sessions to be non-empty, the persistent slot to be unchanged by the terminal message, and no payload in storage.
